newsitem.title: USA: IDEX acquires U.K.-based pump manufacturer.
newsitem.headline: IDEX acquires U.K.-based pump manufacturer.

text.p: IDEX Corp said Friday it has completed acquisition of Terry Harrison Holdings Ltd., a maker of Blagdon air-operated diaphragm pumps.
The company is near Newcastle, England, and has annual sales of about $8 million.
The company will operate as Blagdon Pump Ltd, a unit of IDEX, and its products will continue to be sold under the Blagdon name.
Terry Harrison, a former owner of the business, is retiring but will be a consultant to the business.
IDEX said the company's products complement its existing Warren Rupp air-operated diaphragm pump business and will function as a part of that business unit.
IDEX makes fluid handling and industrial products.
